races.paceDynamic: Three confirmed front-runners in Reliable Ricki, Stay Salty, and Indefensible will create a fierce early battle, with Vidmiyr and Lady Hornblower likely to track just behind. The sustained gallop over this mile trip will stretch the field and test stamina reserves on the good to firm ground. Hold-up horses like Thunderhoof, Horu Kanu, and Decem Starr will find themselves with plenty to do from the back. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early fractions war.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop Maintained
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders engage from the start and maintain a solid clip throughout
scenarios.body: The pace will be testing but not suicidal, allowing the best horse tracking in second or third to strike decisively. Prominent runners with tactical speed will benefit most from this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and tire dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses will get their perfect setup with a strong pace to aim at and weakening leaders. The closers will have time to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Early
scenarios.trigger: If one or more of the expected leaders decides to sit and wait rather than engage
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more moderate, turning this into a sprint finish where tactical positioning matters more than stamina. Late speed becomes crucial over staying power.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the three leaders (likely Stay Salty or Reliable Ricki) gets loose and dictates solo
scenarios.body: An uncontested leader could prove difficult to peg back on this good ground over a mile. The remaining pace horses battle for second while the winner stays clear.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Reliable Ricki's fitness after 224 days off - any signs of rustiness early could eliminate a key pace angle
Monitor if Stay Salty shows any reluctance to engage early given his 61-day break, which could alter the entire pace scenario
Observe Decem Starr's early position with new headgear - if he's closer than usual it suggests connections expect the strong pace
Check if any of the three expected leaders (Reliable Ricki, Stay Salty, Indefensible) get shuffled back early, reducing the pace pressure
Watch Vidmiyr's position tracking the leaders - if he's closer than second or third he may have gone too early

races.paceDynamic: Rose Of Honour will lead uncontested from the stalls with no other committed pace-setters in this small field. The prominent runners Territorial Knight and Brummell will track in second and third, but neither has the early speed to pressure Rose Of Honour's tempo. This creates a soft lead scenario where Rose Of Honour can dictate terms through comfortable fractions, with the hold-up horses Akkadian Thunder, Rousing Encore and Papa Cocktail needing to navigate around tired leaders in the straight. The tactical verdict strongly favours front-running and prominent racing styles who can secure good positions without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Rose Of Honour jumps cleanly and faces no early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: Rose Of Honour will control the pace through easy fractions and have enough left to repel late challenges. The front-running style gets maximum benefit from this small field lacking early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If Territorial Knight or Brummell can track Rose Of Honour closely without overracing
scenarios.body: The prominent pair will be perfectly positioned to strike in the final furlong as Rose Of Honour potentially stops after a long lead. Their tactical positioning beats both the tiring leader and the hold-up horses stuck behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong with Rose Of Honour pressed by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: Akkadian Thunder or Rousing Encore can benefit from a true-run race where the early pace collapses. Their closing style thrives when leaders have battled through honest fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Papa Cocktail Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Papa Cocktail gets a perfect trip tracking the pace from his low draw
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old can exploit his 12lb weight advantage and recent good form at this trip. His hold-up style could pay off if others go too fast early.

watchPoints.text: Rose Of Honour's jumping - if she misses the break badly the entire pace dynamic shifts dramatically
Territorial Knight and Brummell positioning - if either presses Rose Of Honour early it changes everything
Papa Cocktail's draw and early positioning - needs to avoid being shuffled back in small field
Akkadian Thunder's urgency - must show more tactical speed than usual to avoid being stranded
Going conditions firming throughout the day - may favour the front-running Rose Of Honour's style

races.paceDynamic: Mafting will take the lead from the break with Sixpack and Pleasant Man settling just behind in prominent positions. The small field and lack of other confirmed pace-setters means Mafting can dictate terms without pressure, likely setting a steady rhythm over this extended trip. The hold-up trio of Saratoga Gold, Tazaman and Dreams Fled Away will track the leaders from the rear but face a tactical disadvantage with limited pace to aim at. This race shape strongly favours the front-running and prominent horses who can control the tempo and have first run on their rivals.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mafting Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Mafting gets an uncontested lead and sets steady fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can kick clear approaching the straight while the prominent horses Pleasant Man and Sixpack get first run on the hold-up brigade. The backmarkers struggle to make up ground against horses who've had everything their own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Sixpack and Pleasant Man apply early pressure to Mafting
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to set up the race for those tracking just behind the leaders who can pounce when the front-runner tires. Both prominent runners have recent form and tactical speed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Flies
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly sedate and collapses in the straight
scenarios.body: Saratoga Gold or Tazaman can unleash finishing kicks from off the tempo when the leaders stop. The extended absence becomes irrelevant if they retain their old ability to quicken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If Dreams Fled Away has retained ability despite the long layoff
scenarios.body: The 270-day absence masks retained talent and the light weight allows a surprise strike from the rear. Barry Brennan's minimal recent runners makes this hard to assess.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Mafting gets away with soft fractions in front as the hold-up horses will struggle to peg back an uncontested leader
Monitor Pleasant Man's early positioning as he could provide the main threat to Mafting's control of the pace
Check Saratoga Gold's early alertness after the long break as ring-rustiness could compromise his finishing kick
Watch Tazaman's jumping from the stalls as any slow start will make his hold-up task even harder in a small field
Observe Dreams Fled Away's general wellbeing in the parade ring given the 270-day absence and minimal stable activity

races.paceDynamic: Grey Force will likely lead or sit prominently early with no other confirmed front runners in this field of predominantly hold-up horses. The pace will be steady rather than searching, as eight of nine runners prefer to settle and come from behind. This creates a tactical race where the leaders won't face early pressure but will need to sustain their effort when the large pack of hold-up horses mount their challenges in the final 2-3 furlongs. This race shape strongly favours horses with early pace who can control the tempo, as they'll dictate terms to a field that wants to wait and pounce.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Grey Force gets an easy lead and controls the gallop
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Grey Force to dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when the field winds up. Hold-up horses face a wall of traffic as they all make their moves simultaneously.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rush Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect conditions to unleash late runs with the race becoming a sprint finish. Class horses with finishing kick benefit most from this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Grey Force sets steady pace but one horse tracks closer than expected
scenarios.body: A horse breaking from the hold-up pack to sit second/third gets the best of both worlds - avoiding traffic but staying in touch. They can strike approaching the furlong pole before the back markers arrive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Grey Force doesn't show early pace or gets headed quickly
scenarios.body: Multiple horses surge forward creating messy fractions and an uneven gallop that suits nothing. The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial and form hard to assess.

watchPoints.text: Grey Force must show early pace or this race becomes a tactical mess with multiple horses going forward late
Traffic problems likely in straight as eight hold-up horses all need racing room simultaneously
Tekitoff's positioning crucial - needs to avoid getting boxed in behind the wall of hold-up horses
Forever Twenty and Too Darn Spicy both returning quickly from recent runs, monitor for signs of fatigue
Track Trucial Pearl for market confidence given trainer's recent good form and horse's improving efforts

races.paceDynamic: Magic Music and Lumenbourg will ensure a solid early gallop in this 7f handicap, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. The pace should be honest rather than frantic, given it's just two natural leaders in a field of ten. A large contingent of hold-up horses including Zubaru, Maxi Boy, Evocative Spark, Chifa, Valentine Catcher and Oscar's Sister will look to time their runs from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers and front-runners who can secure good early positions, as the weight of hold-up horses may struggle to make ground against an honest but not searingly fast gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Magic Music and Lumenbourg maintain a steady but controlled early pace
scenarios.body: The honest gallop allows one of the pace-setters to kick clear in the final furlong, with the hold-up brigade struggling to make meaningful ground. The prominent racers Straight A and Mr Cool are best placed to capitalise if the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent horses strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine enough to stretch the field but not fast enough to stop the leaders
scenarios.body: The race sets up perfectly for horses racing in second or third, allowing them to inherit the lead as the front-runners tire. Straight A and Mr Cool can time their challenges perfectly from their stalking positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes surprisingly strong between Magic Music and Lumenbourg
scenarios.body: The front-runners go too fast and come back dramatically, allowing the large pack of hold-up horses to mount a late charge. Evocative Spark and Zubaru have the best recent form to capitalise on such a collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If one of Magic Music or Lumenbourg settles for second and the pace becomes pedestrian
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole, favouring horses with natural speed regardless of running style. This tactical affair could suit any horse with a strong turn of foot.

watchPoints.text: Magic Music and Lumenbourg must both go forward early - if one settles back the pace could collapse completely
Evocative Spark carries strong recent form but relies on others going fast enough early to set up his late run
Mr Cool returns from 38-day break for Charlie Johnston whose runners often need their comeback runs
Both Julie Camacho runners Lumenbourg and Oscar's Sister return after 197 days off which raises fitness questions
Several inexperienced jockeys aboard including 3lb claimer Luke Catton on pace-setter Magic Music
